description: Server entry point for a Remix application handling server-side rendering and request handling, including bot detection and CORS headers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers and delegates request processing to bot or browser-specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot (crawler) requests, streaming the response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, streaming the response.
